Return a bounded inventory of discoverable operations, ownership, and execution availability. (alias: ls)

Usage:
  tadx capability list [flags]

Aliases:
  list, ls

Flags:
      --domain string     filter by exact command domain (alias: --dom)
  -h, --help              help for list
  -l, --limit int         maximum capabilities to return, up to 10000 (alias: --lim) (default 20)
      --mutation          filter by remote mutation status (alias: --mut)
      --owner string      filter by exact owner (alias: --own)
      --product string    filter by product availability (alias: --prd)
      --resource string   filter by exact resource (alias: --res)

Global Flags:
      --config string   path to the non-secret TADX configuration file (alias: --cfg)
  -f, --full            show expanded bounded details (alias: --ful)
      --json            render machine-readable JSON instead of TOON (alias: --jsn)
